text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d s-t-o-c-k with a l-o-g-o n-a-m-e that c-l-o-s-e-l-y r-e-s-e-m-b-l-e-d the a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-a-t-i-v-e b-r-a-n-d and l-e-f-t a t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k

2) the actor f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n n-u-m-b-e-r-s on the e-t-i-q-u-e-t-t-e s-t-e-c-k-e-r-s and s-a-v-e-d the e-d-i-t-e-d i-m-a-g-e a-s-s-e-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-a-t-c-h t-r-a-c-e-a-b-i-l-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l

3) the actor f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g-s to m-a-t-c-h the r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d r-a-n-g-e and s-t-o-r-e-d the a-l-t-e-r-e-d c-s-v f-i-l-e in the s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-i-v-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-n-s-o-r c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n c-r-o-s-s c-h-e-c-k

4) the actor d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d the p-a-l-e-t-t-e-s to a p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y n-e-t-w-o-r-k before the i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n w-i-n-d-o-w and r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d the d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e o-f-a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-t-t-e-s-t-a-t-i-o-n

5) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g to c-l-o-s-e the m-a-t-t-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d and d-e-l-e-t-e-d the l-o-c-a-l b-u-f-f-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y h-a-s-h v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of the f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d
